title: 第一卷 第13章 高贵的满相族第一卷 第14章 再哭我就挖出你的眼睛
lines: “对了，糯米，你想买什么？”
这时，陈昭宁侧身看向低着头的糯米，好奇问道。
她想起离开山洞时，糯米就说过想来城里置办不少东西。
糯米眨了眨眼，看了眼陈渊和李伟，低声道：“宁姐姐，我要先保密，要是被你们知道，就不算惊喜了。”
“哦～～原来是这样。”李伟嘿嘿一笑，“那我们可就拭目以待了。”
陈渊也跟着笑了笑。
陈昭宁抿唇浅笑，觉得这个人小鬼大的丫头，还真是挺有意思的。
一行人便在镇上闲逛起来，顺路采买粮油米面。
连日来顿顿吃野味，众人早已吃腻。
几人还添置了一口铁锅，让李伟背在身后。
几人逛了一圈又一圈，兴致越来越高。越往城镇中心走，人流越是密集，周遭也愈发热闹。
人群往来之间，陈渊猛地回头，脸色一变：“糯米呢？”
他转头看向身旁的李伟，急声问道：“不是你一直拉着她手的吗？”
“没有啊，我还以为是你牵着她呢！”
李伟一脸茫然。
“糟了，她定是独自去买东西了，这镇子鱼龙混杂，她一个人族小孩子，容易被人欺负。”
陈昭宁神色微变，“快，我们分头去找！”
三人瞬间焦急起来，立刻在人群中穿梭，四处搜寻糯米的身影。
此地本就秩序混乱，冲突斗殴乃是常事，在这里若是人族死一个，旁人大多冷眼旁观，只当是看热闹。
因为人族是最低贱的生灵。
三人脸色愈发难看。
陈昭宁已是灵窍境修士，竟丝毫没有察觉糯米悄悄离开，心中满是疑惑。
唯有陈渊心头一沉。
陆大叔本是僵尸，糯米的来历恐怕也绝不简单。
就连他，都时常感知不到糯米的气息，那丫头有时就像一道无形的影子。
镇子不算大，三人把街巷全都找了一遍，始终不见糯米踪迹。
“糯米到底要买什么？为何非要偷偷一个人去？”
李伟又急又疑，眼底满是焦灼。
陈昭宁看着陈渊和李伟身上脏污、不合身的衣衫，忽然开口，“我们去成衣铺看看。”
陈渊闻言眼睛一凝，随即无奈轻叹：“唉，这傻丫头。”
全镇只有这一家成衣铺。
店家脑后留着一撮鼠尾辫，其余头发尽数剃光，脑门油光锃亮。
见陈渊三人进门，他直接无视衣着狼狈的陈渊与李伟，目光落在气质不凡的陈昭宁身上，堆起一脸笑意：
“客官，想买什么样的衣裳？小店款式齐全，亦可量身定做。”
“你可见过一个八九岁的小姑娘进来？齐肩短发，圆圆的脸蛋，脸上有两个小酒窝，笑起来眼睛弯成月牙，还露着一对小虎牙。”
陈昭宁满心焦急，快速描述着糯米的模样。
店家眼神闪烁，语气不耐，“客官，来往小姑娘太多，我并未见过你说的人。”
陈昭宁刚燃起的希望，瞬间沉入谷底。
相处多日，她早已真心喜欢这个乖巧的小丫头，此刻心急如焚。
陈渊自进门起，便一直留意着店家。
见对方眼神躲闪，又扫过店内各处，忽然在角落发现一个黑色布袋。
content_en:
"By the way, Nuomi, what do you want to buy?"
At this time, Chen Zhaoning turned sideways and looked at Nuomi, who had his head lowered, and asked curiously.
She remembered that when she left the cave, Nuomi had said that she wanted to come to the city to buy a lot of things.
"I want..."
Nuomi blinked, glanced at Chen Yuan and Li Wei, and whispered: "Sister Ning, I want to keep it a secret first. If you guys find out, it won't be a surprise."
"Oh~~ So that's it." Li Wei chuckled, "Then we'll see."
Chen Yuan also smiled.
Chen Zhaoning pursed his lips and smiled, thinking that this little brat girl was really interesting.
The group of people wandered around the town, buying grain, oil, rice and noodles along the way.
Everyone is tired of eating wild game after eating it for the past few days.
Several people also bought an iron pot for Li Wei to carry on his back.
A few people walked around and around, becoming more and more interested. The further you go towards the center of the town, the denser the crowds become and the more lively the surrounding area becomes.
As the crowd was passing by, Chen Yuan suddenly turned his head and his face changed: "Where is Nuomi?"
He turned to look at Li Wei beside him and asked anxiously: "Weren't you the one holding her hand all the time?"
"No, I thought you were holding her hand!"
Li Wei looked confused.
"Oops, she must have gone shopping alone. This town is full of people. She is a human child and can easily be bullied."
Chen Zhaoning's expression changed slightly, "Quick, let's go look for him separately!"
The three of them suddenly became anxious and immediately shuttled through the crowd, searching for Nuomi.
This place is inherently chaotic, and conflicts and fights are common. If a human dies here, most of the others will look on indifferently, just watching the fun.
Because humans are the lowest creatures.
The expressions of the three of them became increasingly ugly.
Chen Zhaoning was already a monk in the spiritual aperture realm, but he didn't notice Nuomi leaving quietly at all, and he was full of doubts in his heart.
Only Chen Yuan's heart sank.
Uncle Lu is originally a zombie, and the origin of Nuomi is probably not simple either.
Even he often couldn't feel Nuomi's breath, and the girl was like an invisible shadow sometimes.
The town is not that big, so the three of them searched all the streets and alleys, but there was still no trace of Nuomi.
"What on earth do you want to buy Nuomi? Why do you have to go there secretly?"
Li Wei was anxious and suspicious, his eyes full of anxiety.
Chen Zhaoning looked at the dirty and ill-fitting clothes on Chen Yuan and Li Wei, and suddenly said, "Let's go to the clothing store and have a look."
Chen Yuan's eyes narrowed when he heard this, and then he sighed helplessly: "Oh, what a silly girl."
……········
There is only one ready-made clothing store in the whole town.
The shopkeeper had a rat-tail on the back of his head, and the rest of his hair was shaved off, leaving his forehead shiny.
Seeing Chen Yuan and the others entering the door, he ignored the disheveled Chen Yuan and Li Wei, and his eyes fell on Chen Zhaoning, who had an extraordinary temperament, with a smile on his face:
"Sir, what kind of clothes do you want to buy? The store has a full range of styles and can also be customized."
"Have you ever seen an eight or nine-year-old girl come in? She has short shoulder-length hair, a round face, and two small dimples. When she smiles, her eyes turn into crescents, and she also shows a pair of small tiger teeth."
Chen Zhaoning was filled with anxiety and quickly described the appearance of Nuomi.
"Oh?"
The store owner's eyes flickered and his tone was impatient, "Sir, there are too many young girls coming and going. I have never seen the person you mentioned."
Chen Zhaoning's newly ignited hope suddenly sank to the bottom.
After spending many days together, she had already truly fallen in love with this sweet little girl, and now she was extremely anxious.
Chen Yuan has been paying attention to the store since he entered the door.
Seeing the other person's eyes dodge, he scanned around the store and suddenly found a black cloth bag in the corner.
